name: Vorpal Sword
description: A longsword whose blade sings a high, thin note as it cuts the air.
body:
## What it does

Any sword that cuts can carry this edge; this one is a longsword. It strikes far truer and harder than a plain sword, and it cuts through resistance to slashing damage as though it were not there.

## Beheading

On a 20 against a creature with at least one head, the blade takes one off, and the creature dies if it cannot live without it. A creature that needs no head, or is too large or immune, takes far more slashing damage instead.

damage.note: on a 20 against a creature it cannot behead

features.name: Vorpal
features.text: It ignores resistance to slashing damage. On a 20 it beheads a creature that has a head and is not immune.
